items.title: Flutter Riverpod 3.x StateProvider to NotifierProvider Migration
items.summary: In Riverpod 3.x, StateProvider is deprecated or unavailable. Always use NotifierProvider with an explicit Notifier class and semantic methods.
keyRules: Never use StateProvider in Riverpod 3.x
Encapsulate state modifications in explicit semantic methods (e.g. .unlock(), .add())
Keep build() pure and synchronous where possible, or use AsyncNotifier for async initialization

items.title: Firestore Dynamic Demo Data Seeding with User Preferences
items.summary: Hardcoded demo seeds break filter discovery. Refactor seed generators to accept dynamic parameters (gender, category, location) for realistic testing.
keyRules: Never hardcode static arrays for discovery demo features
Allow seed profiles to accept user preference filters
Include dynamic timestamps and diverse mock attributes

items.title: Flutter AdMob Monetization with Session-Based Feature Unlocking
items.summary: Pattern for monetizing premium features with rewarded ads, blurring locked content, and synchronizing unlock state across views with NotifierProvider.
keyRules: Blur or shroud locked components with an enticing preview
Handle ad load failures gracefully with fallback retry or temporary grace period
Persist unlock state across app lifecycle sessions using shared_preferences or Hive

items.title: SwiftUI Modern Safe Area Management via safeAreaInset
items.summary: Avoid fragile manual padding or Spacer offsets for floating bottom controls. Use .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) to respect tab bars and home indicators across all iPhones.
keyRules: Never use fixed hardcoded padding like .padding(.bottom, 100) for bottom bars
Use .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) to automatically calculate home indicator and tab bar offsets
Ensure content stays interactive without clipping under hardware bezels

items.title: Resolving iOS Xcode Resource Fork Detritus & Codesign Errors
items.summary: Xcode code signing fails with 'resource fork, Finder information, or similar detritus not allowed'. Resolve cleanly using xattr.
items.codeSnippet:
# Strip extended AppleDouble and provenance attributes recursively
xattr -cr .
# Verify no hidden attributes remain
xattr -lr .
keyRules: Run `xattr -cr <project_dir>` before building to clear AppleDouble metadata
Keep Bundle Identifier aligned across Debug and Release profiles
Verify entitlements are signed before requesting Keychain or CloudKit capabilities

items.title: The Double-Bezel (Doppelrand) Hardware-Grade Card Architecture
items.summary: Cards should never be flat boxes on a gray background. Engineer nested enclosures like precision-machined hardware with outer ring and inner core specular highlight.
keyRules: Concentric border radii: innerRadius = outerRadius - padding
Never use harsh drop shadows: use multiple diffused ambient layers
Include an inner specular top highlight to simulate physical glass/machined aluminum

items.title: Clean Light Modern Typography & Color Harmonies
items.summary: Ban generic system fonts and dull gray palettes. Pair modern geometric sans with rich slate hierarchy and soft candy pastel accents.
items.codeSnippet:
/* Design Tokens */
--font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif;
--color-bg: #F8FAFC;       /* Crisp porcelain background */
--color-surface: #FFFFFF;  /* Pure white cards */
--color-text-main: #0F172A;/* Deep midnight slate */
--color-text-muted: #64748B;/* Refined cool slate */
--color-accent-gel: #818CF8;/* Translucent gel highlight */
keyRules: Always precede major section titles with a micro-pill eyebrow tag
Use generous line heights (1.5 - 1.6) and letter spacing (-0.02em on large headings)
Never use 100% pure black text on pure white: use deep slate (#0F172A) for optical warmth

items.title: The 18-Second High-Retention Launch Video Structure
items.summary: Proven 18-second video blueprint engineered for TikTok, X, and App Store preview conversions with a 72%+ completion rate.
items.codeSnippet:
0.0s - 2.5s : The Disruption Hook (visual shock or bold contrarian statement)
2.5s - 5.0s : The Pain Point (visceral friction of existing outdated tools)
5.0s - 9.0s : The Magical Solution Reveal (fluid animated hero product feature)
9.0s - 14.0s: The Kinetic UI Proof (rapid high-speed demonstration of speed)
14.0s - 18.0s: The Memorable Brand Payoff & Instant Download Call to Action
keyRules: Hook within the first 1500ms or 65% of viewers swipe away
Sync keyframe transitions to high-tempo 128 BPM audio ticks
Render in dual aspect ratios: 21:9 for App Store desktop and 9:16 vertical for social

items.title: Clean Architecture & Test-Driven Development (TDD) Standard
items.summary: Every product must have a strict 4-layer separation: Presentation, State, Domain, and Data. Write tests before writing logic.
keyRules: Domain layer must have zero dependencies on Flutter UI or external packages
Write failing unit test -> write minimal code to pass -> refactor cleanly
Always mock external network or database drivers in tests

items.title: Omnichannel Launch Package: X, Product Hunt, TikTok & LinkedIn
items.summary: Never post identical copy across platforms. Adapt voice and format to match platform mechanics.
items.codeSnippet:
/* Platform Matrix */
X/Twitter   : High-conviction maker story + 18s video + 'Here is what we learned' thread
Product Hunt: Craftsmanship breakdown + live demo link + comment reward loop
TikTok/Reels: 9:16 vertical 'I was tired of X so I built Y' relatable format
LinkedIn    : Engineering architecture diagram + scalability insights
keyRules: Include a strong clickable link and specific clear CTA in every launch post
Engage with first 20 commenters within 10 minutes to trigger algorithm reach boost
Provide open-source or behind-the-scenes value to build long-term goodwill

items.title: The 5 Gel Personal Assistants Collaborative Group Chat Protocol
items.summary: The 5 Gel Assistants (Gelly, Bloop, Pip, Mochi, Spark) form an autonomous creative agency. They discuss, challenge, and build upon each other's ideas in a live group chat.
items.codeSnippet:
1. Gelly (Squad Lead): Synthesizes goals, keeps focus, coordinates deliverables.
2. Bloop (Idea Innovator): Explores wild brainstorms, user delight, and unexpected features.
3. Pip (Tech Builder): Maps clean architecture, database schemas, and engineering steps.
4. Mochi (Aesthetic & UX): Enforces clean light visuals, soft shadows, and micro-interactions.
5. Spark (Viral Hype): Tests audience sentiment, crafts launch hooks, and plans distribution.
keyRules: Every assistant speaks in their distinct, friendly, humorous voice
Assistants reference and bounce off previous remarks naturally
Never output boring corporate filler: provide actionable, brilliant insights

items.title: Zero External Cloud Dependency & Local Privacy Guarantee
items.summary: ButaAI runs 100% locally on Apple Silicon Metal with zero cloud API keys, storing all memory and knowledge on the user's disk.
keyRules: Zero API keys required for core operations
User product ideas and code never leak to third-party cloud servers
Memory and instincts persist indefinitely in version-controlled JSON files
